title: Dental care during pregnancy
what: You can and should get dental treatment during pregnancy. The doctor chooses safe numbing medicine and the right time for treatment.
why: For tooth decay, bleeding gums, toothache, and also for a routine checkup and cleaning.
duration: a visit usually takes 30 to 60 minutes
tell_doctor: How many weeks pregnant you are
How your pregnancy is going and if there are any problems
What medicines and vitamins you take
If you feel sick or dizzy

prepare.title: Timing
prepare.text: Routine treatment is easiest in the second trimester. Sudden pain is treated at any stage.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Have a light meal 1 to 2 hours before the visit.

prepare.title: Your doctor
prepare.text: You can talk to your OB-GYN first, especially if your pregnancy has problems.

bring: Your pregnancy record or notes, if you have them
steps: Tell the dentist how many weeks pregnant you are
The chair is set up so you are comfortable, tilted a bit to your side late in pregnancy
The doctor checks your teeth and gums
If needed, you get numbing medicine that is safe in pregnancy
Your tooth is treated or cleaned
An X-ray is taken only if needed, with your belly covered
feel: The numbing injection is a quick sting
Lying on your back for a long time can be uncomfortable. Tell the doctor, and they will take a break
after: You can eat once the numbness wears off
Brush your teeth twice a day. Your gums may bleed more often
Your next visit is as your doctor plans
red_flags: Severe toothache or a swollen cheek: do not wait, see a dentist
Dizziness and weakness in the chair: tell the doctor right away
Belly pain or bleeding from the vagina: call emergency services

faq.q: Is numbing medicine safe during pregnancy?
faq.a: Yes. Some medicines are used in pregnancy. Putting up with pain is worse for you.

faq.q: Can I have a dental X-ray?
faq.a: Only if it is really needed. The dose is very small, and your belly is covered with a protective apron.

reminders.text: Dentist tomorrow. Tell the doctor how many weeks pregnant you are and bring your list of medicines.
